In [[mathematics]], an '''Alexander matrix''' is a presentation matrix for the [[Alexander invariant]] of a [[knot (mathematics)|knot]]. The [[determinant]] of an Alexander matrix is the [[Alexander polynomial]] for the knot.<ref name=Collins2006>{{cite web|last=Collins|first=Julia|title=Knot Theory|url=http://www.maths.ed.ac.uk/~jcollins/Knot_Theory.pdf|accessdate=21 September 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130921080732/http://www.maths.ed.ac.uk/~jcollins/Knot_Theory.pdf|archive-date=2013-09-21|url-status=dead}}</ref>
